source_scope.assessment: One shared app, rig, registry and generic player. The new channel translates only the existing lower oral-surface owner inside the existing 40-source-pixel rise envelope. Fixed source pigment/UV, unit scales and opaque anatomical owners are retained. No new face artwork, texture stretching, mesh deformation, anatomy crossfade, wide-eye controls or held EXP-003/007 are introduced.

reference.assessment: Readable neutral, closed smile, single relaxed open accent, closed follow-through, lingering smile and exact neutral recovery. Direct eyes and no authored FX. This is an interpretation of static reference art, not recovered animation or identical painted artwork. Canonical face, segmented white enamel and rigid brow curvature differ visibly from the reference.
